glossary.aisunqun: aisu- — to come; participle in -nqun, 'the ones coming' [來的每]
glossary.aisuqu-ji: aisu- — to come, to approach; imperfective participle -qu with accusative -ji, 'the coming (of them)' [來的行]
glossary.ažiγ̇ai: a- — to be; past ažiγ̇ai, 'there was' [有來]
glossary.ažuγ̇u: a- — to be; past ažuγ̇u, 'there was, he was' [有來]
glossary.aγtastu: aγta — gelding; plural -s plus -tu 'having', 'having geldings' [騸馬每有的]
glossary.aγ̇užam-boroγ̇ul-un: Aγ̇užam-Boroγ̇ul — Aqujam-Boroqul; genitive -un after a consonant [人名的]
glossary.batačiγan: Batačiγan — Batachiqan, son of Börte Chino [人名, 'a personal name']
glossary.bijü: bü- — to be; present bijü, 'there is' [有]
glossary.boro: Boro — Boro, a horse's name (boro 'grey') [馬名] · also 'blue-grey, grey', a colour (here of a cloak: boro örmüge-ben, 'one's own blue-grey cloak'; Ming 靑 'blue-green')
glossary.boržigidai-mergen: Boržigidai-Mergen — Borjigidai the Marksman; the Borjigin clan takes its name from him [兒名]
glossary.burqan-qaldun: Burqan-Qaldun — the holy mountain of the Mongols [山名]
glossary.böleg: böleg — a group, a body, a band of people [叢]
glossary.börte: börte — blue-grey, the grey of a wolf's coat; also the ancestor's name Börte [蒼色] · also the woman's name Börte (Temüjin's betrothed; Ming (女)名 'a woman's name')
glossary.böġesü: bü- — to be; conditional böġesü, 'if it be, if it is that' [有來] · also glossed 有呵, with 呵 the marker of 'if' (Ming 有來 or 有呵); with ele, 'if only … be'
glossary.büleġe: bü- — to be; past büleġe, 'there was, used to be' [有來]
glossary.dair: Dair — Dayir, a horse's name [馬名]
glossary.deġereče: deġere — above, top; ablative -če, 'from above, from the top' [上自]
glossary.deġü-deġen: deġü — younger brother; dative-locative with reflexive-possessive, 'to his own younger brother' [弟自的行]
glossary.deġü-jüġen: deġü — younger brother; accusative with reflexive-possessive, 'his own younger brother' [弟自的行]
glossary.deġü-lüġe-beġen: deġü — younger brother; -lüġe 'together with' + -beġen reflexive-possessive: 'with his own younger brother' [弟一同自的]
glossary.dobün-mergen: Dobun-Mergen — Dobun the Marksman; spelled Dobün here, the same name [人名]
glossary.dunda: dunda — middle, in the middle of [中] · also 'half, part-way' (adverb, before a possessive: dunda keġelitei 'half-belly-having'; Ming 半孕 'half-pregnant')
glossary.duwa-soqor: Duwa-Soqor — Duwa the One-eyed (soqor 'blind, one-eyed') [兒名]
glossary.ese: ese — not (negates a past action; ülü negates present or future) [不曾] · before a converb: ese toγ̇aγdažu 'not yet counted' (as ese ögdegsen 'not given' in §6), where ülü is the usual negative of a converb
glossary.gergei: gergei — wife, the woman of a household [妻]
glossary.gergeitü: gergei — wife; with -tü 'having', so 'having a wife, married to' [妻有的]
glossary.huruγ̇u: huruγ̇u — downstream, following the course, along [順]
glossary.hužaγ̇ur: hužaγ̇ur — root, origin, the stock a line springs from [根源]
glossary.in-ü: in-ü — his, her, its (third-person genitive, placed after its noun) [他的]
glossary.irebe: ire- — to come; past -be, 'came' [來了] · also where the Ming has 去了 'went' (Boγ̇orču … urižu irebe, §95, 'came'; ire- means 'come', so the Ming 去了 is not translated)
glossary.irgen: irgen — people, the common folk of a camp or realm [百姓]
glossary.ketülžü: ketül- — to cross over (water); imperfective converb -žü, 'crossing' [渡着]
glossary.köġün: köġün — son [子] · also read as a collective, 'sons', before a list of several names (Menen-Tudun-(n)u köġün … doloγ̇an, 'seven'; the plural köġüd is the usual form) · also 'lad, young man' (Ming 後生 'junior'), as in köġün küġün 'a young man'
glossary.külüġüd: külüg — a swift, outstanding horse; plural -üd [駿, plural]
glossary.maral: maral — hind, the female red deer [鹿]
glossary.monγolžin-toγ̇a: Monγolžin-Toγ̇a — Mongoljin-Qo'a (toγ̇a/γoγ̇a 'fair, comely') [婦人名, 'a woman's name']
glossary.na: -(n)a — dative-locative: at, in, to (back-vowel form) [行] · also a particle na (Ming 好生 'well, very'; sense uncertain), in bolγaqu na žöb, 'to be made, na, right' (§126)
glossary.ne: -(n)e — dative-locative: at, in, to (front-vowel form) [行] · also on names, De-Sečen-(n)e and Höġelün-(n)e, 'to De-Sechen, to Högelün' (Ming 行), where the (n) is Shiratori's
glossary.neġürid: neġüri — one stage of a nomadic move, the ground covered between camps; plural -d [程, 'a stage of a journey']
glossary.neġüžü: neġü- — to move camp, to migrate; converb, 'moving camp' [起着]
glossary.nidütü: nidün — eye; with -tü 'having', 'having an eye' [眼有的]
glossary.nu: -(n)u — genitive: of (back-vowel form; the n appears after a vowel-final stem) [的] · also printed after stems that already end in n (Menen-Tudun-(n)u, Qačin-(n)u, Qaγan-(n)u, Onan-(n)u), where the (n) is Shiratori's; the Ming 的 as elsewhere · also küġün-(n)u, 'of a person'
glossary.nutuγlažu: nutuγla- — to camp, to occupy as pasture (from nutuγ, home ground); converb, 'camping' [營盤做着]
glossary.nü: -(n)ü — genitive: of (front-vowel form) [的] · also printed after an n-final stem (Tumbinai-Sečen-(n)ü) and after back-vowel names (Qabul-Qaγan-(n)ü), where the front-vowel form breaks harmony; the Ming 訥 writes -nu and -nü alike
glossary.onan: Onan — the Onon, the river of Chinggis's homeland [河名, 'name of a river']
glossary.orožu: oro- — to enter, to come in; converb [入着]
glossary.qaraqu: qara- — to look, to see; imperfective participle -qu [望見]
glossary.qaraγ̇utai: qara — black; with -tai 'having' (the front-vowel twin of -tu), so 'black' [黑]
glossary.qojar: qojar — two; it follows the pair it counts [兩箇] · also before the thing counted: qojar sumu, 'two arrows' (Ming 兩隻 'two (arrows)')
glossary.qoričar-mergen: Qoričar-Mergen — Qorichar the Marksman (mergen 'good shot, wise') [兒名]
glossary.sali-qačaγ̇u-jin: Sali-Qačaγ̇u — Sali-Qachaqu; genitive -jin after a vowel [人名的]
glossary.tamača-jin: Tamača — Tamacha; genitive -jin after a vowel [人的]
glossary.tede: tede — those, they (plural of tere) [那的每]
glossary.tergen-ü: terge — cart, wagon; genitive, 'of the cart' [車的] · also read as tergen (the n-stem 'cart', as in tergen-dür) + genitive -ü, 'of the cart' (Ming 車 的)
glossary.teriġün-e: teriġün — head, source, beginning; here dative-locative, 'at the head of' [源行]
glossary.teṅgeri-eče: teṅgeri — Heaven, the sky as a power; here ablative -eče, 'from Heaven' [天處]
glossary.teṅgis: Teṅgis — the Tenggis, an inland sea or great lake [水名, 'name of a water']
glossary.töregsen: töre- — to be born; past participle -gsen, 'born, the one born' [生了的]
glossary.tüṅgelig: Tüṅgelig — the Tünggelig, a stream [水名]
glossary.ögdegsen: ög- — to give; passive -de- plus past participle -gsen, 'having been given' [與了的]
glossary.ölžige-de: ölžige — the front-board or forward seat of a cart; dative-locative [前行]
glossary.ügülerün: ügüle- — to speak, to say; converb -rün, 'saying' [說]
glossary.üžere: üže- — to see; purposive converb -re, 'in order to see' [看]
glossary.čima-da: či — thou; dative-locative čima-da, 'to thee, for thee' [你行]
glossary.čiṅgis: Čiṅgis — Chinggis, the title borne by Temüjin from 1206 [Ming gloss: 太祖名, 'the name of Taizu']
glossary.žajaγ̇atu: žajaγ̇a — destiny, fate allotted; here with -tu 'having', 'destined' [命有的]
glossary.žalaγ̇utu: žalaγ̇u — young man, retainer; with -tu 'having' [後生有的]
glossary.γarba: γar- — to go out, to go up; past -ba, 'went up' [上去了]
glossary.γažar-a: γažar — earth, ground, country; here dative-locative, 'over the land' [地行] · also 'in the land, in the country' (keġer γažar-a 'in the wild country'; Ming 裏 'in')
glossary.γoγ̇ai: γoγ̇ai — pale, wan, fallow; also the name Qo'ai [慘白色]
glossary.γujuja: γuju- — to ask for, to request; first-person volitional -ja, 'let me ask' [索]
glossary.irgen-dür: irgen-dür — among the people, in the folk (irgen 'people' + dative-locative -dür, front-vowel form) [百姓 裏]
glossary.kürüġesü: kürü- — to reach, arrive; conditional converb -ġesü, 'when/if arriving' (verb, converb) [到呵]
glossary.ünen-kü: ünen-kü — truly, true (ünen 'true' + -kü, adjectival ending, uncertain) [實 也]
glossary.γoγ̇a: γoγ̇a — beautiful, fair; also the name element Qo'a (adjective) [美] · also 'pale' (of a colour; Ming 慘白), against 'beautiful, fair' (Ming 美)
glossary.jeketei: jeke-tei — great, having greatness (jeke 'great' + possessive -tei, front-vowel form) [大 有的]
glossary.alan-γoγ̇a: Alan-Γoγ̇a — Alan-Qo'a, a woman's name (personal name) [(女名)]
glossary.neretei: nere-tei — named, having a name (nere 'name' + possessive -tei) [名(有的)]
glossary.ber: ber — even, also (particle) [也] · also glossed Ming 裏 'in', where it may rather be the instrumental -ber, 'with' (uncertain)
glossary.ögteġei: ög- — to give; read as passive -te- plus past -ġei, 'was given'; uncertain, inferred (verb, passive past) [與]
glossary.köl-barγužin: Köl-Barγužin — Köl-Barqujin, a place name; what köl means is not known (place name) [地名]
glossary.tögüm-ün: Tögüm-ün — of Tögüm, 'hollow, low ground' per the Ming (name + genitive -ün, front-vowel form after a consonant) [窊的]
glossary.barγudai-mergen: Barγudai-Mergen — Barqudai the marksman, a man's name (personal name) [人名 的]
glossary.barγužin-γoγ̇a: Barγužin-Γoγ̇a — Barqujin-Qo'a, a woman's name (personal name) [女名]
glossary.ni: -(n)i — accusative, marks the object (e.g. ökin-(n)i 'the girl' as object); the Ming writes 行 (case suffix) [女 行] · also on names and on müren (Temüžin-(n)i, De-Sečen-(n)i, müren-(n)i), where the (n) is Shiratori's; in places topic-like, 'as for Temüjin' (Ming 行 or (行))
glossary.qori-tumad-un: Qori-Tumad-un — of the Qori-Tumad, a people (tribal name + genitive -un, back-vowel form after a consonant) [部落名(的)]
glossary.qorilartai-mergen: Qorilartai-Mergen — Qorilartai the marksman, a man's name (personal name) [人名 行]
glossary.ariγ-usun: Ariγ-Usun — Ariq-Usun, a place name (ariγ 'clean', usun 'water') (place name) [地名 行]
glossary.barγužin-γoγ̇ača: Barγužin-Γoγ̇a-ča — from Barqujin-Qo'a (name + ablative -ča; the full -ača/-eče occur elsewhere, and what governs the short form is unclear) [婦人名(自)]
glossary.tere: tere — that, that one; also 'he, she' (demonstrative and third-person pronoun; plural tede) [那般]
glossary.γažar-turi: γažar-tur(i) — in the land (γažar 'land' + dative-locative -tur, a variant of -dur; the (i) belongs to the reflexive -(i)jan that follows) [地 自的行]
glossary.jan: -(i)jan — reflexive-possessive, one's own (back-vowel form; the token left after γažar-tur(i)- and γažar(i)-) [地 自的行] · also after aqui-dur(i)- (a participle with dative-locative) · also after quruγ̇ud(i)-, 'one's own fingers' (a plural noun with the accusative i; Ming 指頭 自的行) · also after tergen-dur(i)- ('to one's own cart'), amin(i)- ('one's own life', accusative), γar-tur(i)- ('in one's own hand') and niγ̇ur-tur(i)- ('in one's own face'), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after oin-dur(i)- ('in one's own mind') and morin(i)- ('one's own horse', accusative), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after aγ̇ur(i)- ('one's own breath, rage'), botoγan(i)- ('one's own camel foal') and turγaγ̇ud(i)- ('one's own companions'), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also -(i)jan after kituγai-jar(i)- (instrumental, 'with one's own knife') · also after tuk(i)- ('one's own banner'), qurdun(i)- and dun(i)- ('one's own fast horse'), qujag(i)- ('one's own armour') and sumun(i)- ('one's own arrow'), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after bolulčaγsan(i)- (a past participle with the accusative, 'what they had done together, their own'; Ming 共 做了的 自的行) and after jor(i)- ('his own sounding arrowhead'; the Ming 自的 has no 行), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after Uruγ̇ud(i)- and Moṅγud(i)- (people names; Ming 一種 自的行), 'one's own Uruqud, one's own Mongqud'
glossary.keremün: keremün — squirrel (the Ming's 靑鼠 'blue squirrel') (noun) [靑鼠]
glossary.göreġetei: göreġe-tei — having game (göreġe 'game, wild animals' + possessive -tei) [野物 有的]
glossary.γažari: γažar(i) — land, followed by the reflexive -(i)jan 'one's own'; the (i) is a linking vowel or perhaps the accusative -i, uncertain (noun + reflexive-possessive stem) [地 自的(行)]
glossary.qorilaldužu: qorila-ldu-žu — forbidding one another (qorila- 'forbid, restrain' + reciprocal -ldu- + converb -žu) [相禁約着]
glossary.maγ̇ulaldužu: maγ̇ula-ldu-žu — troubling one another (maγ̇ula- 'vex, treat ill', from maγ̇u 'bad', + reciprocal -ldu- + converb -žu) [煩惱着]
glossary.qorilar: Qorilar — the Qorilar, a clan name (clan name) [姓氏]
glossary.oboγtu: oboγ-tu — having a clan (oboγ 'clan, lineage' + possessive -tu, back-vowel form) [姓(有的)]
glossary.bolžu: bol- — to become; converb -žu, 'becoming' (verb, converb) [做着]
glossary.görüġüli: görüġüli — catchable, able to be taken in the hunt; inner form unclear, uncertain (adjective) [可捕]
glossary.saitu: sai-tu — having good, fine (sai 'good' + possessive -tu, back-vowel form) [好有的]
glossary.keġen: keġe- — to say; keġen 'saying', the converb that closes a quotation (verb, converb) [麽道]
glossary.ežed: ežen — lord, master; plural ežed, 'masters' (noun + plural -d) [主每]
glossary.burqan-bosqaγsan: Burqan-Bosqaγsan — Burqan-Bosqaqsan, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.sinči-bajan: Sinči-Bajan — Sinchi-Bayan, a man's name (bajan 'rich') (personal name) [人名]
glossary.urjaṅqai-dur: Urjaṅqai-dur — among the Uriangqai (tribal name + dative-locative -dur, back-vowel form) [部落名 裏]
glossary.aisun: aisu- — to come, approach; ending -n, converb or participle, uncertain (verb) [來]
glossary.alan-γoγ̇a-ji: Alan-Γoγ̇a-ji — Alan-Qo'a as object (name + accusative -ji after a vowel) [(女名) 行]
glossary.tende: tende — there, then (from tere 'that'; locative adverb) [那裏]
glossary.γujužu: γuju- — to ask for, demand (here, a bride); converb -žu, 'asking for' (verb, converb) [索着]
glossary.abuγsan: ab- — to take, get (here, a wife); past participle -γsan, 'having taken, the one who took' (verb, participle) [要了的]
glossary.josun: josun — custom, reason, the right way (noun) [理]
glossary.teimü: teimü — so, thus, it is so (adverb) [那般]
glossary.dobün-mergen-dür: Dobün-Mergen-dür — to Dobun the marksman (name + dative-locative -dür, front-vowel form) [(人)名 行]
glossary.irežü: ire- — to come; converb -žü, 'coming' (verb, converb) [來着]
glossary.töreġülbi: töre- — to be born; causative -ġül- plus past -bi, 'caused to be born': bore, begot (verb, causative past) [生了]
glossary.bügünütei: Bügünütei — a son's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.belgünütei: Belgünütei — a son's name; the Ming gloss cannot be read (personal name) [人起]
glossary.nereten: nere-ten — having names, named (nere 'name' + plural possessive -ten) [名(有)的(每)]
glossary.köġütü: köġü-tü — having sons (köġün 'son' + possessive -tü, front-vowel form) [子(有的)]
glossary.tedüi: tedüi — so much, so, thus (adverb) [那般] · also 'so, then, thereupon' (a sentence adverb; Ming 便 'at once') · also 'so much, like, as' after a genitive, the size comparison (Ming 般) · also a pronoun, 'those, so many' (Ming 那些 'those')
glossary.atala: a- — to be, remain; converb -tala, 'while, until' (verb, converb) [住間]
glossary.ügei: ügei — without, there is not (negative particle) [無]
glossary.boluba: bolu- — to become; past -ba, 'became' (verb, past tense) [做了]
glossary.boluγsan: bolu- — to become; past participle -γsan, 'the one who became, having become' (verb, participle) [做了 的]
glossary.köġüd: köġün — son; plural köġüd, 'sons' (noun + plural -d) [子每] · also 'lords, princes' in the address Taičiγud köġüd (Ming 大王每)
glossary.abaγa-juγ̇an: abaγa-juγ̇an — own paternal uncle (abaγa 'father's younger brother' + reflexive-possessive -juγ̇an; here 'their own') [叔叔(自的)行]
glossary.uruγ-a: uruγ-a — as kin, to the kin (uruγ 'kin, relatives, offspring' + dative -a) [親戚行]
glossary.ülü: ülü — not (negates present or converb forms) [不] · also before participles (ülü boluqui, ülü ögteküi), 'not'
glossary.bolγan: bol- — to become; causative -γa- plus -n, 'making, treating as'; converb (verb, causative converb) [做]
glossary.doramžilažu: doramžila- — to look down on, slight; converb -žu (verb, converb) [下覻着]
glossary.qaγačažu: qaγača- — to part from, separate from; converb -žu (verb, converb) [分離着]
glossary.gežü: ge- — to cast aside, abandon, per the Ming; possibly the 'say' verb keġe- in an idiom, uncertain; converb -žü (verb, converb) [撇着]
glossary.neġübe: neġü- — to move camp; past -be, 'moved camp' (verb, past tense) [起了]
glossary.oboγtan: oboγ-tan — having a clan (oboγ 'clan, lineage' + plural possessive -tan) [姓(有的)]
glossary.bolba: bol- — to become; past -ba, 'became' (verb, past tense) [做了]
glossary.teġün-ü: teġün-ü — of that, his, her (tere, stem teġün- before case endings, + genitive -ü, front-vowel form) [那的]
glossary.toqočaγ-ündür: Toqočaγ-Ündür — Toqochaq-Ündür, a hill (ündür 'high') (place name) [地名 山名]
glossary.göreġelere: göreġele- — to hunt; purposive converb -re, 'in order to hunt' (verb, converb) [捕獸]
glossary.urjaṅqadai: Urjaṅqadai — a man of the Uriangqai (Urjaṅqai + -dai, person of; the suffix uncertain) [部落名]
glossary.čüġe-buγu: čüġe-buγu — three-year-old deer (čüġe 'three years old' + buγu 'deer, stag') (noun phrase) [三歲 鹿]
glossary.alažu: ala- — to kill; converb -žu (verb, converb) [殺︀着]
glossary.abid: abid — entrails, innards (Ming 肚臟); read as abi, a stem inferred from the Ming, plus plural -d (noun) [肚臟]
glossary.širažu: šira- — to roast; converb -žu (verb, converb) [燒着]
glossary.bükü-ji: bü- — to be; participle -kü, 'the one who is' + accusative -ji (verb, participle + case) [有的]
glossary.žoluγažu: žoluγa- — to meet, come upon; converb -žu (verb, converb) [遇着]
glossary.sirolγada: širolγa- — to give roast (meat), apparently from šira- 'roast'; stem and ending -da uncertain, read as a request (verb) [燒(肉)與的]
glossary.kēžüġü: keġe- — to say (written kē- when contracted); past narrative -žüġü, 'said' (verb, past tense) [說了]
glossary.ögsü: ög- — to give; optative -sü, 'let it be given, I will give' (verb, optative) [與(呵)]
glossary.aγ̇ušigitu: aγ̇ušigi-tu — having lung (aγ̇ušigi 'lung' + possessive -tu, back-vowel form) [肺有的]
glossary.žildu: žildu — half the body cavity, half-carcass, per the Ming (noun) [半截腔子]
glossary.abču: ab- — to take; converb -ču, 'taking' (verb, converb) [要着]
glossary.čüġe-buγu-jin: čüġe-buγu-jin — of the three-year-old deer (čüġe-buγu + genitive -jin after a vowel) [三歲鹿 的]
glossary.miqa: miqa — meat; stem miqan before an ending (noun) [肉]
glossary.gübčin-i: gübčin-i — the whole, entire, as object (gübčin 'whole' + accusative -i after a consonant) [全行]
glossary.ögbe: ög- — to give; past -be, 'gave' (verb, past tense) [與了]
glossary.čüġe-buγu-ji: čüġe-buγu-ji — the three-year-old deer as object (čüġe-buγu + accusative -ji after a vowel) [三歲鹿 行]
glossary.ačižu: ači- — to carry as a load, pack; converb -žu (verb, converb) [駄着]
glossary.aisurun: aisu- — to come; converb of time -run, 'when coming' (verb, converb) [來時]
glossary.žaγ̇ura: žaγ̇ur-a — midway, in the middle (žaγ̇ur 'middle' + dative-locative -a, back-vowel form) [路間] · also 'among, between' (Ming 間), in žaba žaγ̇ura dürüžu, 'into the crevice'
glossary.jadaṅgi: jadaṅgi — poor, in want (from jada- 'be lacking') (adjective) [窮乏]

glossary.kötölžü: kötöl- — to lead, draw along; converb -žü (verb, converb) [牽引着]
glossary.jabuqu-ji: jabu- — to walk, go; participle -qu 'the one who goes' + accusative -ji (verb, participle + case) [行(的行)]
glossary.žolγažu: žolγa- — to meet; converb -žu (verb, converb) [遇着]
glossary.či: či — you, thou (second-person singular pronoun) [你] · also (uncertain) a particle after a noun, 'as for, if' (Ming 呵), as in ger či oira bijü, not the pronoun 'you'
glossary.asaγasuγ̇asu: asaγa- — to ask; conditional converb -γ̇asu 'if/when'; the element -su- is unaccounted for, uncertain (verb, converb) [問呵]
glossary.bi: bi — I (first-person singular pronoun; the stems na-, nama-, min- before case endings) [我] · also 'is, exists' (verb, perhaps a short form of bü-, compare bijü; Ming 有)
glossary.maγ̇aliγ-bajaγ̇udai: Maγ̇aliγ-Bajaγ̇udai — Maqaliq-Bayaqudai, a clan name; the Ming glosses it 姓氏 'clan name' in one place and 人名 'personal name' in another, and it is the same name (clan name) [姓氏]
glossary.jadažu: jada- — to be in want, to lack; converb -žu (verb, converb) [窮乏着] · also jada- 'to be unable', converb -žu, 'being unable' (Ming 不得着, 不能着), as in köġüd(i)-jen gelin jadažu, 'unable to drive off'
glossary.jabumu: jabu- — to walk, go about; present -mu, 'goes, is going' (verb, present tense) [行有]
glossary.göre: göre — first half of göreġesün 'game', which the edition prints split across two entries (noun, split word) [野物]
glossary.ġesün-ü: -ġesün-ü — second half of the split göre-ġesün 'game', with genitive -ü, 'of game' (noun, split word + genitive) [的]
glossary.miqan-ača: miqan-ača — from the meat (miqa, stem miqan, + ablative -ača, back-vowel form) [肉裏]
glossary.na-da: na-da — to me (bi, stem na-, + dative-locative -da, back-vowel form) [我行]
glossary.ög: ög- — to give; the bare stem is the imperative, 'give!' (verb, imperative) [與]
glossary.üge-dür: üge-dür — in the word, in the speech (üge 'word' + dative-locative -dür, front-vowel form) [言語 裏]
glossary.oreġele: oreġele — one of a pair, a piece; form uncertain (noun/numeral) [一隻]
glossary.quγulžü: quγul- — to break off; converb -žü, 'breaking' (verb, converb) [折着]
glossary.ögčü: ög- — to give; converb -čü after a consonant, 'giving' (verb, converb) [與着]
glossary.abčiražü: abčira- — to bring along (ab- 'take' plus a second verb); form uncertain; converb -žü (verb, converb) [將(來)着]
glossary.žaružu: žaru- — to employ, use (a person); converb -žu (verb, converb) [使着]
glossary.aqu: a- — to dwell, stay; participle -qu, 'the one who stays' (verb, participle) [住] · also 'there is' (Ming 有; a- as 'be', not 'dwell')
glossary.dobun-mergen-i: Dobun-Mergen-i — Dobun the marksman as object (name + accusative -i) [(人名)行]
glossary.boluγsa: bolu- — to become; first part of the past participle -γsa(n), which the edition breaks across two entries (verb, split participle) [做了]
glossary.n-u: -n-u — last letter n of the split participle boluγsa-n plus genitive -u, completing boluγsan-(n)u (split ending, genitive) [的]
glossary.ügeiġüi: ügeiġüi — without, none; ügei with a redundant negative -ġüi, uncertain (negative particle) [無]
glossary.böġed: bü- — to be; ending -ġed, 'being so, even so', uncertain (verb, converb) [便]
glossary.buγu-qatagi: Buγu-Qatagi — Buqu-Qatagi, a son's name (personal name) [(兒)名]
glossary.buqatu-salži: Buqatu-Salži — Buqatu-Salji, a son's name (personal name) [(兒)名]
glossary.bodončar-muṅqaγ: Bodončar-Muṅqaγ — Bodonchar-Munqaq, a son's name; muṅqaγ is an epithet 'simple' (personal name) [(兒)名]
glossary.urida: urida — formerly, before, in front (adverb) [在前]
glossary.dobun-mergen-eče: Dobun-Mergen-eče — from Dobun the marksman (name + ablative -eče, front-vowel form) [(人名)處]
glossary.eke-jüġen: eke-jüġen — own mother (eke 'mother' + reflexive-possessive -jüġen; here 'their own') [娘 自的]
glossary.alan-γoγ̇a-jin: Alan-Γoγ̇a-jin — of Alan-Qo'a (name + genitive -jin after a vowel) [母名 的]
glossary.ečine: ečine — behind, at the back (adverb/postposition) [背處]
glossary.ügüleldürün: ügüle- — to speak; reciprocal -ldu- + converb of time -rün, 'while speaking together' (verb, converb) [共說]
glossary.bidan-u: bidan-u — of us, our (bida 'we, inclusive', stem bidan-, + genitive -u, back-vowel form) [咱的]
glossary.ujaγaja: ujaγaja — near kin of the same branch; form unclear, uncertain (noun) [房親]
glossary.ügelġüi: ügelġüi — without; spelling variant, perhaps a misprint, of ügeiġüi, uncertain (negative particle) [無]
glossary.böġetele: bü- — to be (böġe- before an ending); converb -tele, 'while, although' (verb, converb) [旣]
glossary.ede: ede — these (plural of ene) (demonstrative pronoun) [這(的每)]
glossary.teġün-ü-ġei: teġün-ü-ġei — his own, his (tere, stem teġün-, + genitive -ü + -ġei, which I take as 'belonging to'; uncertain) [他的]
glossary.bi-že: bü- — to be; stem bi- before -že, 'indeed is' (verb + assertion particle -že, 'indeed, surely') [有]
glossary.keleldüküi-ji: kele- — to speak; reciprocal -ldü-, participle -küi, accusative -ji, 'the speaking together' (verb, participle + case) [共說的行]
glossary.an-u: an-u — their (back-vowel companion of in-ü, third-person genitive placed after its noun) [他的]
glossary.uqažu: uqa- — to understand, perceive, find out; converb -žu (verb, converb) [覺着]
glossary.küṅsilemel: küṅsilemel — a word of unclear form; the Ming 臘 suggests 'winter-cured, preserved (meat)', uncertain (noun/adjective) [臘]
glossary.činažu: čina- — to boil; converb -žu (verb, converb) [煮︀着]
glossary.köġüdi: köġüd(i) — sons; the (i) is read as the accusative -i (the Ming marks 行) before the reflexive -(i)jen (köġün + plural -d) [子每(自的)行] · also köġüd(i)-jer-en, 'with one's own sons' (Ming 兒子(每)自的行), where the (i) is Shiratori's linking vowel before the instrumental -jer, as in tümed(i)-jer, not the accusative

glossary.žergelen: žergelen — in a row (žerge 'row, rank' + -len, adverbial, uncertain) [列]
glossary.saγ̇ulžu: saγ̇ul- — to seat, make sit; converb -žu (verb, converb) [坐着]
glossary.nižiġed: nižiġed — one each, one apiece; form uncertain (distributive numeral) [每一隻]
glossary.müsüd: müsü — arrow shaft; plural müsüd (noun + plural -d) [箭榦(每)]
glossary.quγuludqun: quγul- — to break; imperative(-optative) -(u)dqun, 'do break' (the Ming adds 您 'you'); the inner -ud- is unexplained (verb, imperative) [折折您]
glossary.nižiġed-i: nižiġed-i — one each as object (nižiġed + accusative -i) [一隻行]
glossary.baiγ̇ulqun: bai- — to stand, be; causative -γul- + imperative-optative -qun, 'let it stand, stop' (verb, imperative) [敎停住]
glossary.quγučižu: quγul- — to break; -či- 'each, one by one', uncertain; converb -žu (verb, converb) [各折折着]
glossary.oγ̇orba: oγ̇or- — to go off, depart; stem unknown, Ming 去了 may also mean 'done', uncertain; past -ba (verb, past tense) [去了] · also oγ̇or- 'to let fly, send off' (Ming 放了 'let go', of a hawk or bird); past -ba
glossary.qamtu: qamtu — together, jointly (adverb) [一同] · also glossed Ming 一箇 'one' ('together' remains the reading; sense uncertain)
glossary.čuγlažu: čuγla- — to gather up, bundle; converb -žu (verb, converb) [束着]
glossary.kēžü: keġe- — to say (written kē- when contracted); converb -žü, 'saying' (verb, converb) [說着]
glossary.tabuγ̇ula: tabun-γ̇ula — all five together (tabun 'five' + -γ̇ula 'all together, the whole lot') [五箇]
glossary.čuγtai: čuγ-tai — bundled, having a bundle (čuγ 'bundle' + possessive -tai, back-vowel form) [束的]
glossary.küġüleldün: küġüleldün — each man, one by one; form uncertain (distributive) [每人]
glossary.barižu: bari- — to take hold of, grasp; converb -žu (verb, converb) [拿着]
glossary.bitüġülžü: bitüġül- — to take in turn (Ming 輪着); form uncertain; converb -žü (verb, converb) [輪着] · also 'taking round, parading' (Ming 敎徇着), the causative converb of §81's bitüġülün
glossary.quγuluu: quγul- — to break; converb -un, 'breaking'; printed quγuluu but the Han 侖 reads lun, so quγulun (verb, converb) [折折]
glossary.jadaba: jada- — to lack, be in want; also 'be unable' (Ming 不能了); past -ba (verb, past tense) [不能了]
glossary.ügülebi: ügüle- — to speak; past -bi, 'said' (verb, past tense) [說了]
glossary.ta: ta — you, plural polite (second-person plural pronoun; stem tan- before case endings) [(您)]
glossary.min-u: min-u — my, of me (bi, genitive stem min-, + -u, set after its noun) [我的]
glossary.nama-ji: nama-ji — me, as object (bi, stem nama-, + accusative -ji after a vowel) [我行]
glossary.köġüd-i: köġüd-i — the sons, as object (köġün + plural -d + accusative -i) [子每(行)] · also 'the princes' as object (Ming 大王每(行)), of the Činos princes
glossary.ken-ü: ken-ü — whose, of whom (ken 'who' + genitive -ü, front-vowel form) [誰的]
glossary.sereldün: sere- — to be wary, suspect; reciprocal -ldu- + converb -n, 'suspecting one another' (verb, converb) [疑的]
glossary.keleldümüi: kele- — to speak; reciprocal -ldu- + present -müi, 'speak together' (verb, present tense) [共說有]
glossary.sereküi: sere- — to suspect; participle -küi, 'the suspecting, suspicion' (verb, participle/noun of action) [疑的]
glossary.tan-u: tan-u — your (plural) (ta, stem tan-, + genitive -u) [您的]
glossary.žöb: žöb — right, correct, proper (adjective) [是] · also 'exactly, just', before tende 'just then' (Ming 正)
glossary.sünid: sün — night; plural sünid, 'nights' (noun + plural -d) [夜(每)] · also a clan name, the Sünid (Ming 一種(名) 'a kind of …'), perhaps the same word with the plural -d, but not the 'nights' (proper name)
glossary.ger-ün: ger-ün — of the tent, of the house (ger + genitive -ün, front-vowel form after a consonant) [房的]
glossary.erüge: erüge — smoke-hole, roof-window of the tent (Ming 天窗 'skylight') (noun) [天窗]
glossary.dotoγa-jin: dotoγa-jin — of the door-lintel, the upper edge of the doorway, per the Ming; uncertain (dotoγa + genitive -jin after a vowel) [門額 的]
glossary.gegeġer: gegeġe-r — in the light, by brightness (gegeġe 'light' + -r, instrumental or locative, uncertain) [明裏]
glossary.biližü: bili- — to stroke, rub; converb -žü, 'stroking' (verb, converb) [摩着]
glossary.keġeli-dür: keġeli-dür — into the belly (keġeli 'belly' + dative-locative -dür, front-vowel form) [肚皮 裏]
glossary.siṅgekü: siṅge- — to soak in, penetrate; participle -kü (verb, participle) [透]
glossary.γarurun: γar- — to go out; converb of time -urun, 'when going out' (verb, converb) [出時]
glossary.sara-jin: sara-jin — of the moon (sara 'moon' + genitive -jin after a vowel) [月 的]
glossary.kili-jer: kili-jer — by or in a ray (kili 'ray, beam', inferred from the Ming 透入光裏, + -jer instrumental or locative); uncertain [透入光裏]
glossary.sičabalžažu: sičabalža- — to crawl, creep; converb -žu (verb, converb) [爬 着]
glossary.γarqu: γar- — to go out; participle -qu, 'the one who goes out' (verb, participle) [出]
glossary.ügüled: ügüle- — to speak; -d, a verb ending that goes with a plural subject (here ta 'you'), uncertain (verb) [說]
glossary.teġü-ber: teġü-ber — by that, therefore (tere, stem teġü-, + instrumental -ber) [爲那般]
glossary.uqaγ̇asu: uqa- — to understand; conditional converb -γ̇asu, 'if/when understanding' (verb, converb) [省呵]
glossary.temdeg: temdeg — sign, mark; the Ming reads it 'plain, clear' (noun) [明白]
glossary.teṅgiri-jin: teṅgiri-jin — of Heaven (teṅgeri 'Heaven, sky as a power' + genitive -jin after a vowel) [天 的]
glossary.bijü-že: bü- — to be; present bijü, 'there is' + assertion particle -že, 'indeed' (verb + particle) [有 也者︀]
glossary.teriġü: teriġü — head (teriġü + possessive -tü; printed teriġü,ü but the Han reads teriġütü, 'having a head, headed') [頭 (有的)] · also plain 'head' with no ending (noun; Ming 頭)

glossary.küġün-dür: küġün-dür — to or with a person (küġün 'man' + dative-locative -dür, front-vowel form) [人 行]
glossary.qanilγan: qanil- — to liken, compare; form unclear; converb -γan, 'comparing' (verb, converb) [比着]
glossary.qamuγ-un: qamuγ-un — of all, of everyone (qamuγ 'all' + genitive -un, back-vowel form after a consonant) [普的]
glossary.qād: qaγan — sovereign, emperor; plural qād, contracted, 'rulers' (noun, plural) [帝王(每)] · also read with the Ming 王子 'princes'
glossary.boluγ̇asu: bolu- — to become; conditional converb -γ̇asu, 'if/when it becomes' (verb, converb) [做呵]
glossary.qaračus: qarača — commoner, subject; plural qaračus, 'commoners' (noun + plural -s) [下民]
glossary.uqad-že: uqa- — to understand; -d, a verb ending that goes with a plural subject, uncertain; + assertion particle -že, 'indeed, surely' (verb + particle) [省]
glossary.keġebe: keġe- — to say; past -be, 'said' (verb, past tense) [說了]
glossary.köġüd-teġen: köġüd-teġen — own sons (köġün + plural -d + reflexive-possessive plural -teġen; here 'her own') [子(每) 自的(行)]
glossary.süjüġer: süjüġer — teaching, instruction, per the Ming; form uncertain (noun) [敎訓]
glossary.keġeli-eče: keġeli-eče — from the belly (keġeli + ablative -eče, front-vowel form) [肚皮 處]
glossary.törebe: töre- — to be born; past -be, 'was born' (verb, past tense) [生了]
glossary.tuγarun: tuγarun — just now, a moment ago (adverb) [恰纔]
glossary.ken-e: ken-e — by or to whoever (ken 'who' + dative-locative -e, front-vowel form) [任誰] · also interrogative, 'to whom?, by whom?' (Ming 誰行), where the entry's 'whoever' does not fit (ken-e boldaqu-ju bi, 'to whom am I made ...?')
glossary.kilbar-a: kilbar-a — easily (kilbar 'easy, light' + dative-locative -a used as an adverb) [容易 行]
glossary.quγugdaqun: quγul- — to break; passive -γda- + imperative-optative -qun, 'let it be broken' (verb, passive imperative) [被折折]
glossary.ejeten: ejeten — counsel-having, 'in counsel' (Ming 商量有的); with nigen 'one', 'united'; form uncertain, -ten read as the plural possessive (adjective) [商量有(的每)]
glossary.ken-e-ber: ken-e-ber — even by anyone (ken 'who' + dative-locative -e + particle -ber 'even, also') [任誰 也]
glossary.bolqun: bol- — to become; here 'be undone' (Ming 壞 'spoil'), with imperative-optative -qun; uncertain (verb, imperative) [壞]
glossary.keġebi: keġe- — to say; past -bi, 'said' (verb, past tense) [說了]
glossary.bolbi: bol- — to become; past -bi, 'became' (verb, past tense) [做了]
glossary.boluγsan-u: boluγsan-u — of the one who became (bolu- + participle -γsan + genitive -u) [做了 的]
glossary.aqa-nar: aqa-nar — elder brothers (aqa + plural -nar, back-vowel form) [兄 每]
glossary.deġü-ner: deġü-ner — younger brothers (deġü + plural -ner, front-vowel form) [弟 每]
glossary.ideġe-ben: ideġe-ben — own food (ideġe 'food' + reflexive-possessive -ben; here 'their own') [茶飯︀ 自的(行)]
glossary.qubijaldurun: qubija- — to divide, share out; reciprocal -ldu- + converb of time -run, 'when dividing among themselves' (verb, converb) [分時]
glossary.dörbeġule: dörben-ġule — all four together (dörben 'four' + -ġule 'all together, the whole lot') [四箇]
glossary.abulčaba: ab- — to take; -ulča- 'among themselves, jointly' + past -ba, 'took jointly' (verb, past tense) [相要了]
glossary.bodončar: Bodončar — Bodonchar, a son's name (personal name) [(兒名)]
glossary.muṅqaγ: muṅqaγ — simple, dull, foolish (adjective; also an epithet in a name) [(愚)]
glossary.toγ̇an: toγ̇a- — to count, reckon; converb -n, 'counting' (verb, converb) [數]
glossary.toγ̇aγdažu: toγ̇a- — to count, reckon; passive -γda- + converb -žu, 'being counted' (verb, passive converb; Ming 被 passive, 敎 not accounted for) [被敎着]
glossary.daγ̇aritu: daγ̇ari — sore, ulcer; possessive -tu, 'having sores, sore-backed' (noun + possessive) [瘡 有的]
glossary.γodoli: γodoli — bald, bare (adjective) [禿] · also 'arrowhead' (Ming 𩪛頭), not only 'bald, bare'
glossary.seġültü: seġül — tail; possessive -tü, 'having a tail, tailed' (noun + possessive, front-vowel form) [尾(有的)]
glossary.oroγ: oroγ — black-backed, with a black spine (adjective; Ming 黑脊) [黑脊]
glossary.šiṅγula-ji: šiṅγula — blue-grey horse; accusative -ji after a vowel (noun + case; the Ming writes 行) [靑白馬 行]
glossary.unužu: unu- — to ride, mount; converb -žu, 'riding' (verb, converb) [騎着] · also 'mounting, climbing up' onto the cart (Ming 上着)
glossary.üküġesü: ükü- — to die; conditional converb -ġesü, 'if (he) dies' (verb, converb) [死呵]
glossary.üküsügei: ükü- — to die; optative -sügei, 'let (him) die' (verb, optative, front-vowel form) [死也者︀]
glossary.aγ̇asu: a- — to be, to live; conditional converb -γ̇asu, 'if (he) lives' (verb, converb) [活呵]
glossary.asuγai: a- — to be, to live; optative -suγai, 'let (him) live' (verb, optative, back-vowel form) [活也者︀]

glossary.talbiba: talbi- — to let go, set loose, release; past -ba, 'let go' (verb, past tense) [放了]
glossary.balžun-aral: Balžun-Aral — Baljun-Aral, a place on the river; aral perhaps 'island' (place name, compound uncertain) [水名]
glossary.kürčü: kür- — to reach, arrive; converb -čü after r, 'arriving' (verb, converb) [到着]
glossary.kižü: ki- — to do, make; converb -žü, 'making' (verb, converb) [做着]

glossary.kilγasun-bar: kilγasun — tail-hair; instrumental -bar, 'with tail-hair' (noun + case, back-vowel form; Ming 敎) [尾上毛 敎]

glossary.asaraba: asara- — to lift, raise up; past -ba (verb, past tense) [擡擧了]
glossary.ideküi: ide- — to eat; participle -küi, 'what is to be eaten' (verb, participle, front-vowel form) [喫的]

glossary.čino-jin: čino — wolf; genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of the wolf' (noun + case) [狼 的]
glossary.gün-dür: gün — cliff, steep bank; dative-locative -dür, 'at the cliff' (noun + case; the stem is uncertain) [崖 行]

glossary.marijažu: marija- — to watch for, stalk; converb -žu, 'stalking' (verb, converb) [窺覷着]
glossary.qarbužu: qarbu- — to shoot (an arrow); converb -žu, 'shooting' (verb, converb) [射着]
glossary.ideldüġed: ide- — to eat; -ldü- 'together' + converb -ġed, 'eating together' (verb, converb; the Ming 兼 may belong to the whole form) [喫兼着]
glossary.idegsen-i: ide- — to eat; past participle -gsen + accusative -i, 'what has been eaten' (verb, participle + case) [喫了的(行)]
glossary.temküldüžü: temküldü- — to pick up, gather; converb -žü (verb, converb; the stem may hold -ldü- 'together' but is not separable) [拾着]
glossary.ideġed: ide- — to eat; converb -ġed, 'eating, having eaten' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [喫兼着]
glossary.öġer-ün: öġer — own, self; genitive -ün after r (pronoun + case) [自己(的)]

glossary.ireküi: ire- — to come; participle -küi, 'the coming' (verb, participle, front-vowel form) [來的]
glossary.čaγ-tur: čaγ — time, season; dative-locative -tur, 'at the time' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [時 裏]

glossary.qožiγ̇ulas: qožiγ̇ul — withered tree, dead wood (noun; form not analysed, Ming 枯樹); plural -s (plural) [枯樹(每)]
glossary.tutun: tutun — each, every (distributive; the Ming 每, uncertain) [每]
glossary.qunsiγ̇ud: qunsiγ̇u — stench, foul smell; plural -d (noun, plural) [臭︀氣]
glossary.künžiġüles: künžiġül — dry tree, dry wood (noun; form not analysed, Ming 乾樹); plural -s (plural) [乾樹每]

glossary.düiren: Düiren — Düiren, a mountain (place name) [山名]
glossary.gerü-deče: gerü — back, behind; ablative -deče, 'from behind' (noun + case, front-vowel form; the stem is uncertain) [背後]

glossary.odču: od- — to go; converb -ču, 'going' (verb, converb) [去着]
glossary.esüg: esüg — mare's milk (noun; Ming 馬嬭子) [馬嬭子]
glossary.čiležü: čile- — to call, summon, ask for; converb -žü, 'calling' (verb, converb) [喚着]
glossary.ger-türi: ger — dwelling, tent; dative-locative -tür(i), 'to the tent' (noun + case; the (i) is Shiratori's) [房子 自的(行)]

glossary.bodončar-i: Bodončar — Bodonchar; accusative -i, 'Bodončar (object)' (personal name + case) [(人名行)]

glossary.kürbe: kür- — to reach, arrive; past -be, 'reached' (verb, past tense) [到了]
glossary.ba: ba — and, both (conjunction) [并] · also 'we', first-person plural pronoun (Ming 俺, against bida 咱), standing at the head of its clause or after the verb · also 'also, even' after a word (Ming 也), as in ger-tür(i)-jen ba ülü odun

glossary.suraqu-dür: sura- — to ask; participle -qu + dative-locative -dür, 'at the asking' (verb, participle + case) [問的 行]
glossary.qarčiγaitu: qarčiγai — hawk; possessive -tu, 'having a hawk' (noun + possessive) [黃鷹(有的)]

glossary.hörene: hörene — west (noun; Ming 西, reading uncertain) [西]

glossary.qarčiγai-bar: qarčiγai — hawk; instrumental -bar, 'by the hawk' (noun + case, back-vowel form; Ming 敎) [黃鷹 敎]

glossary.burγaliγ: burγaliγ — drifting, fluffy (adjective or adverb; Ming 飄 'float', uncertain) [飄]
glossary.butaražu: butara- — to scatter, disperse; converb -žu, 'scattering' (verb, converb) [散着]
glossary.keisčü: keis- — to blow along; converb -čü, 'blowing' (verb, converb; Ming 刮, perhaps from kei 'wind') [刮着]
glossary.iremü: ire- — to come; present -mü, 'comes' (verb, present tense, front-vowel form) [來有]
glossary.oira: oira — near, close (adjective, adverb) [近] · also 'beside, near by' (Ming 根前)

glossary.qoromud: qoromud — a little, briefly (adverb; Ming 略, form not analysed) [略]
glossary.küliče: küli- — to wait; -če, imperative or hortative, 'wait!' (verb, imperative; the ending is uncertain) [等]

glossary.tüngelig: Tüṅgelig — Tünggelig, a stream (place name; spelt with n here, ṅ elsewhere) [(水名)]
glossary.öġede: öġede — upstream, up (adverb; Ming 逆水 'against the water') [逆水] · also in kei öġede, 'against the wind' (Ming 逆, 逆著︀ 'against'), the same word as 'upstream' read with a different noun
glossary.irebesü: ire- — to come; conditional converb -besü, 'if (he) comes' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [來呵]
glossary.mün: mün — just, the very, indeed (particle; Ming 是 'is', elsewhere 只那 'that same') [是]

glossary.ügülebe: ügüle- — to speak, say; past -be, 'spoke' (verb, past tense) [說了]

glossary.morilaba: morila- — to mount a horse (from morin 'horse'); past -ba, 'mounted' (verb, past tense) [上馬了]

glossary.qaγ̇ulžu: qaγ̇ul- — to rush, run; converb -žu, 'rushing' (verb, converb) [奔着]
glossary.keġelitei: keġeli — belly, womb; possessive -tei, 'having a belly, pregnant' (noun + possessive, front-vowel form) [肚皮有的] · also read as 'pregnant' (Ming 懷孕 'with child')
glossary.eme-ji: eme — woman; accusative -ji after a vowel, 'the woman (object)' (noun + case) [婦人 行]

glossary.žarčiγ̇ud: Žarčiγ̇ud — the Jarchiud, a people (people name, plural in -d) [種名]
glossary.adanqan: Adanqan — the Adanqan, a people (people name) [種名]
glossary.urjaṅqažin: Urjaṅqažin — the Uriangqajin, a clan (clan name) [姓(名)]
glossary.daγ̇uližu: daγ̇uli- — to plunder; converb -žu, 'plundering' (verb, converb; analysis uncertain, Ming 擄) [擄着] · also written with the Ming 虜著︀ 'taking captive'; the stem daγ̇uli- 'to plunder, take captive'
glossary.ideġen-e: ideġen — food; dative-locative -e, 'for food' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [茶飯︀處]

glossary.saγ̇uqu: saγ̇u- — to sit, dwell, live; participle -qu, 'the dwelling' (verb, participle) [住坐 行]

glossary.bodončar-dür: Bodončar — Bodonchar; dative-locative -dür, 'to Bodončar' (personal name + case) [(人名) 行]
glossary.köġülebi: köġüle- — to bear a son (from köġün 'son'); past -bi, 'bore a son' (verb, past tense) [兒生了]
glossary.žad: Žad — the Jad, a people (people name; Ming 世人 'people of the world') [世人]
glossary.irgen-ü: irgen — people; genitive -ü after n, 'of the people' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [百姓的]
glossary.žažiradai: Žažiradai — Jajiradai, a man's name (personal name) [兒名]
glossary.nereidbe: nere — name; -id- 'to provide with' + past -be, 'gave a name' (verb, past tense; analysis uncertain) [名字與了]
glossary.žadaran-u: Žadaran — the Jadaran, a clan; genitive -u, 'of the Žadaran' (clan name + case) [種名 的]
glossary.žadaradai-jin: Žadaradai — Jadaradai, the same man as Žažiradai (personal name; spelling varies); genitive -jin after a vowel (name + case) [人名 的]

glossary.biruγ̇ud: Biruγ̇ud — the Biru'ud, a people (proper name; the ending -d is probably the plural, which the Ming does not mark) [種姓(名)]
glossary.tatar: Tatar — the Tatar, a people (proper name) [(種名)]
glossary.irgen-e: irgen — people; dative-locative -e, 'to, among, by' (noun + case, front-vowel form; the Ming 行) [百姓 行]
glossary.öġesün: öġesün — oneself, himself, emphatic (pronoun; Ming 自己) [自己]
glossary.ökini: ökin — girl, daughter; the (i) is Shiratori's bracketed vowel, read as the accusative, before the reflexive -(i)jen, 'one's own daughter' (noun + case) [女子 自的行]

glossary.odqu: od- — to go; participle -qu, 'the one going' (verb, participle) [去的]

glossary.žüin: Žüin — the Jüin, a people (proper name) [種姓(名)]
glossary.kitad-un: Kitad — the Kitad (Ming 契丹 'Kitan'), a people; genitive -un after a consonant (name + case) [契丹的]
glossary.odqui-dur: od- — to go; participle -qui + dative-locative -dur, 'at the going, when going' (verb, participle + case; Ming 去的 時) [去的 時]
glossary.balaγači: Balaγači — Balaqachi, a man's name (personal name) [(人名)]
glossary.elčini: elčin — envoy, messenger (noun; the (i) is Shiratori's; Ming 使臣行 敎 'to the envoy, cause') [使臣行 敎]

glossary.ügüležü: ügüle- — to speak, to say; converb -žü, 'speaking' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [說著︀]
glossary.ilerün: ile- — to send (as in ilebe, Ming 敎去了); converb of time -rün, 'sending, when sending' (verb, converb; uncertain: here the Ming gives 去 'go', so 'going' is another possible reading) [去]
glossary.köġüd-ün: köġün — son; plural -d + genitive -ün, 'of the sons' (noun + plural + case) [兒子的]
glossary.dundatu: dunda — middle; possessive -tu, 'the middle one' (noun + possessive, back-vowel form) [中間的]
glossary.qutula-da: Qutula — Qutula, a man's name; dative-locative -da after a vowel, 'to Qutula' (name + case; the Ming 行) [(人)名 行]
glossary.qadaγ̇an-taiši-da: Qadaγ̇an-Taiši — Qada'an-Taishi, a man's name (taiši 'prince'); dative-locative -da, 'to' (name + case) [(人)名 行]
glossary.ügüle: ügüle- — to speak, to say; the bare stem, 'say!' (verb, stem used as imperative) [說]
glossary.ulus-un: ulus — realm, state, people; genitive -un, 'of the realm' (noun + case, back-vowel form after a consonant) [國(的)]
glossary.bolužu: bolu- — to become; converb -žu, 'becoming' (verb, converb) [做著︀]
glossary.öki-ben: öki — girl, daughter (a form of ökin without its n); reflexive-possessive -ben, 'one's own daughter' (noun + reflexive-possessive) [女子 自的行]
glossary.hüdeküi-ben: hüde- — to see off, escort; participle -küi + reflexive-possessive -ben, 'one's own seeing-off' (verb, participle + reflexive-possessive) [送的 自(的)行]

glossary.bariγdaγ̇a: bari- — to seize; passive -γda- + past ending -γ̇a, 'was seized' (verb, passive past; the ending is uncertain; Ming 被拿了) [被拿了]
glossary.quruγ̇udi: quruγ̇un — finger; plural -d before the reflexive-possessive -(i)jan, 'one's own fingers' (noun + plural; the (i) is read as the accusative; Ming 指頭 自的行) [指頭 自的行]
glossary.kimül: kimül — fingernail (noun; Ming 指甲) [指甲]
glossary.tamutala: tamu- — to be bare, worn bare (Ming 禿了; the stem is uncertain); -tala, 'until' (verb, converb) [禿了]
glossary.qaγ̇udtala: qaγ̇ud- — to be worn out, ground away (Ming 磨盡了); -tala, 'until' (verb, converb) [磨盡了]
glossary.hači: hači — enmity, vengeance, a feud (noun; Ming 讎) [讎] · also 'requital, repayment' where a kindness is repaid (Ming 讎 read as 'to requite'; uncertain, and it may be another word that the Ming glossed alike)
glossary.aburan: abura- — to repay, requite (Ming 報); converb -n, 'repaying' (verb, converb) [報]
glossary.soridqun: sori- — to try, test (Ming 試); an element -d- (uncertain) + -qun, imperative-optative ending of plural address (compare kesedkün; Ming 您) (verb, imperative; uncertain) [試您]
glossary.keġežu: keġe- — to say; converb -žu, 'saying' (verb, converb; printed -žu though the stem is front-vowel) [說著︀]
glossary.iležüġü: ile- — to send (as in ilebe, Ming 敎去了); past narrative -žüġü, 'sent' (verb, past narrative; uncertain: the Ming 去了有來 reads 'went', which would make the envoy the subject) [去了有來]
glossary.šibaγ̇ulan: šibaγ̇ula- — to hunt with a hawk, fly hawks (Ming 放鷹; the stem is uncertain, perhaps šibaγ̇u 'bird' + -la-); converb -n, 'flying hawks' (verb, converb) [放鷹]
glossary.jabuqui-dur: jabu- — to walk, go about; participle -qui + dative-locative -dur, 'at the going about, while going' (verb, participle + case; Ming 行的 時分) [行的 時分]
glossary.merkid-ün: Merkid — the Merkid, a people; genitive -ün after a consonant (name + case) [種名(的)]
glossary.jeke-čiledü: Jeke-Čiledü — Yeke-Chiledü, a man's name (jeke 'great' + Čiledü) [(人)名]
glossary.olqunuγ̇ud: Olqunuγ̇ud — the Olqunu'ud, a people (proper name; the ending -d is probably the plural, which the Ming does not mark) [種名]
glossary.irgen-eče: irgen — people; ablative -eče, 'from' (noun + case, front-vowel form; the Ming 處) [百姓 處]
glossary.öki: öki — girl, daughter (a form of ökin without its n) (noun) [女子]
glossary.eġüsgežü: eġüsge- — to take a wife, to wed (Ming 取; 'wed' is a reading); converb -žü, 'wedding' (verb, converb) [取著︀] · also eġüsge- 'to begin, set out' (Ming 起着 'rising, setting out'; stem inferred); converb -žü, 'setting out, beginning'
glossary.öngeižü: öngei- — to peer in, look closely (Ming 探著; the stem is uncertain, perhaps related to önge); converb -žü (verb, converb; uncertain) [探著︀]
glossary.üžeġesü: üže- — to see; conditional converb -ġesü, 'if, when (he) looked' (verb, converb; Ming 看呵) [看呵]
glossary.önge: önge — colour, complexion (noun; Ming 顏) [顏]
glossary.žisü: žisü — colour, hue (noun; Ming 色) [色]
glossary.bušitai: buši — other, different; possessive -tai, 'having something different, uncommon' (adjective + possessive, back-vowel form; Ming 別有的) [別有的]
glossary.qatud: qatun — lady; plural -d (Ming 婦人(每)) (noun + plural; uncertain: whether it names the girl, 'a lady', or stands as a plural, 'the ladies', is not settled; the Ming has no 'of rank') [婦人(每)] · also 'queens, ladies', plural of a ruler's wives (Ming 娘子每 'the ladies')
glossary.qarin: qarin — back, again (adverb; Ming 回) [囘] · also 'tribe, division' (Ming 部 'division, section'; sense uncertain), in harban γurban qarin, 'thirteen divisions'
glossary.qaγ̇lžu: qaγ̇l- — to run, rush (Ming 奔; the stem is uncertain); converb -žu, 'rushing' (verb, converb) [奔著︀]
glossary.deġü-ben: deġü — younger brother; reflexive-possessive -ben, 'one's own younger brother' (noun + reflexive-possessive) [弟 (自的)行]
glossary.irežüġü: ire- — to come; past narrative -žüġü, 'came' (verb, past narrative, front-vowel form; Ming 來了) [來了]
glossary.kürküi-lüġe: kür- — to reach, arrive; participle -küi + -lüġe 'together with' (the postposition of deġü-lüġe-beġen) after a participle, 'as soon as' (analysis tentative), 'as soon as arriving' (verb, participle + postposition) [到了 呵]
glossary.čiledü: Čiledü — Chiledü, a man's name (personal name) [(人)名]
glossary.ajužu: aju- — to fear, be afraid; converb -žu, 'fearing' (verb, converb) [怕著︀]
glossary.qurdun: qurdun — swift, quickly (adverb or adjective; the Ming 快 does not say which) [快]
glossary.qubitu: qubi — yellow (horse); possessive -tu, 'yellow-horse-having' (noun + possessive; Ming 黃馬 'yellow horse') [黃馬(有的)]
glossary.qubi-juγ̇an: qubi — yellow horse; reflexive-possessive -juγ̇an, 'his own yellow horse' (noun + reflexive-possessive, back-vowel form) [黃馬 自的]
glossary.deledčü: dele- — to strike, to whip; converb -dču, 'striking' (verb, converb; the d is unexplained, as in uduridču) [打著︀]
glossary.quburi: quburi — hill, rise of ground (noun; the Ming 岡 'ridge') [岡]
glossary.nambalis: nambalis — crossing over, passing across (form uncertain; stem not identified, only the Ming 越過 'cross over'; perhaps a converb in -s) [越過]
glossary.buruqui-luγ̇a: buru- — to hide, turn aside (stem inferred from the Ming 躱 'dodge'); participle -qui + -luγ̇a, the back-vowel partner of -lüġe, 'together with', after a participle 'as soon as' (analysis tentative; not the past -luγ̇a of aluγ̇a) [躱 了呵]
glossary.γurbaγ̇ula: γurban — three; collective -γ̇ula, 'the three together' (numeral + collective; Ming 箇 'item') [三箇]
glossary.udaγ̇alalduba: udaγ̇ala- — to follow close, pursue (stem uncertain; Ming 隨卽趕 'follow and chase'); -ldu- 'together, mutually' + past -ba, 'pursued' (verb, past tense) [隨卽趕了]
glossary.qošiγ̇un: qošiγ̇un — spur, point of a hill (noun; Ming 山觜 'mountain beak') [山觜]
glossary.qučilis: qučili- — to round, go round (stem uncertain); converb -s, 'rounding' (verb, converb; Ming 褁過 'wrap round') [褁過]
glossary.qarižu: qari- — to turn back, return; converb -žu, 'turning back' (verb, converb) [囘著︀]
glossary.tergen-duri: tergen — cart; dative-locative -dur, 'to, at the cart' (noun + case; the (i) is Shiratori's and belongs to the reflexive -(i)jan that follows as the token jan; Ming 車子 + 行) [車子 自的行]
glossary.ireküi-lüġe: ire- — to come; participle -küi + -lüġe 'together with' (the postposition of deġü-lüġe-beġen) after a participle, 'as soon as' (analysis tentative), 'as soon as coming' (verb, participle + postposition) [來了呵]
glossary.höġelün-üžin: Höġelün-Üžin — Högelün-Üjin, a woman's name (personal name, one two-part name) [婦人名]
glossary.haran-i: haran — people, subjects, commoners (noun) + accusative -i 'the people' (noun + case; Ming 人 + 行) [人行]
glossary.uqaba-u: uqa- — to understand, perceive; past -ba + question particle -u, 'understood?' (verb, past + interrogative; the Ming 覺麽 is a question) [覺麽]
glossary.čirai: čirai — face, countenance (noun; Ming 顏色 'colour of the face') [顏色]
glossary.čirai-ača: čirai — face; ablative -ača, 'from the face' (noun + case; Ming 顏色 + 行, which marks the case only loosely) [顏色 行]
glossary.busud: busu — other, not so, different; plural -d, 'the others' (adjective/noun + plural; the Ming 不是 is 'not so'; the sense in its context is uncertain) [不是]
glossary.amin-dur: amin — life, breath; dative-locative -dur, 'in the life' (noun + case; Ming 性命 + 裏) [性命 裏]
glossary.kürküi: kür- — to reach, arrive; participle -küi, 'arriving, the arrival' (verb, participle; Ming 到的) [到的]
glossary.čiraitan: čirai — face; plural possessive -tan, 'those having faces' (noun + plural possessive; Ming 顏色(有的)每 'those with colour'; sense uncertain) [顏色(有的)每]
glossary.amin: amin — life, breath (noun; Ming 性命) [性命]
glossary.ele: ele — emphatic particle: only, but, indeed (Ming 但 'only, but') · after ker, 'how-like, of what sort' (Ming 般 'sort, manner'), where it is not 'indeed'; the particle's force is not settled [但]
glossary.ölžige: ölžige — front of the cart, cart-front (word unclear, the Ming 車前 only; the sense is taken from the context) [車前]
glossary.ökid: ökin — girl, daughter; plural -d, 'girls' (noun + plural; Ming 女子每) [女子每]
glossary.qaraγ̇u: qaraγ̇u — black cart, 'the black one' (stem qara 'black' with an ending not identified; the Ming 黑車 is 'black cart'; uncertain) [黑車]
glossary.olu: olu- — to get, obtain, find; the bare stem, written apart from its ending (verb; the following word i may be the ending, uncertain) [得]
glossary.i: -i — an ending written apart from its stem olu- (probably a future-present, 'will get'; reading uncertain, the Ming gives nothing) [no Ming gloss]
glossary.busu: busu — other, not so (adjective; Ming 別 'other, another') [別]
glossary.nerete-ji: nere — name; possessive -te + accusative -ji, 'the one having a name' (noun + possessive + case; Ming 名字(有)的(行)) [名字(有)的(行)]
glossary.höġelün: Höġelün — Högelün, a woman's name (personal name) [婦人名]
glossary.taki: taki — also, again, too (particle; Ming 也) [也]
glossary.nereidüjü: nere- — to name, call by name (nere 'name' + -id-, uncertain); converb -üjü, 'naming' (verb, converb; same word as nereidčü, here with a different converb spelling; Ming 名喚 'be called') [名喚]
glossary.amini: amin — life; accusative -(i), 'one's own life' (noun + case; the (i) is Shiratori's, the token before the reflexive jan; Ming 性命自的(行)) [性命自的(行)]
glossary.γoloγ: γolo- — to carry off, take away (Ming 刁出去 'carry off in the mouth, go out'; the stem and the imperative -γ are uncertain) [刁出去]
glossary.hünür: hünür — scent, fragrance (noun; Ming 香氣) [香氣]
glossary.hünüsčü: hünüs- — to smell, scent; converb -čü, 'smelling' (verb, converb; Ming 聞 'to smell') [聞者︀]
glossary.jabu: jabu- — to go; the bare stem, imperative, 'go!' (verb, imperative; Ming 行) [行]
glossary.čamča-ban: čamča — shirt, garment; reflexive-possessive -ban, 'one's own shirt' (noun + reflexive-possessive; Ming 衫兒) [衫兒自的(行)]
glossary.mültülžü: mültül- — to strip off, pull off; converb -žü, 'stripping' (verb, converb; Ming 脫) [脫著︀]
glossary.deġerēče: deġere — above, upper; ablative -ēče, 'from above' (adverb + case, front-vowel form with a long ē) [上自]
glossary.naruidču: naru(i)- — to reach, grope; converb -dču, 'reaching' (verb, converb; Ming 探 'probe'; stem uncertain) [探著︀]
glossary.abqui-luγ̇a: ab- — to take; participle -qui + -luγ̇a, the back-vowel partner of -lüġe, 'together with', after a participle 'as soon as taking' (analysis tentative; not the past -luγ̇a of aluγ̇a; Ming 拾要了呵) [拾要了呵]
glossary.qučildužu: qučil- — to round, wrap round; -du- 'together, mutually' + converb -žu, 'wrapping together' (verb, converb; Ming 裹 'wrap') [裹著︀]
glossary.aisuqu-luγ̇a: aisu- — to come; participle -qu + -luγ̇a, the back-vowel partner of -lüġe, 'together with', after a participle 'as soon as coming' (analysis tentative; not the past -luγ̇a of aisuluγ̇a) [來了呵]
glossary.qubi-jin: qubi — yellow horse; genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of the yellow horse' (noun + case) [黃馬 的]
glossary.žuqus: žuqus — hurriedly, in haste (adverb; Ming 急忙) [急忙]
glossary.dutaγ̇ažu: dutaγ̇a- — to flee, run away; converb -žu, 'fleeing' (verb, converb; Ming 走 'run') [走著︀]
glossary.dutaγ̇aba: dutaγ̇a- — to flee, run away; past -ba, 'fled' (verb, past tense) [走了]
glossary.nekežü: neke- — to pursue, chase (stem inferred from the Ming 追趕); converb -žü, 'pursuing' (verb, converb) [追趕著︀] · also 'attacking' (Ming 襲着 'attack'; stem uncertain)
glossary.dabatala: daba- — to cross a pass, pass over; -tala 'until, as far as, while' (verb + terminal converb; Ming 越過 'cross over') [越過]
glossary.hüldežü: hülde- — to chase, overtake (stem inferred from the Ming 趕); converb -žü, 'chasing' (verb, converb) [趕了]
glossary.höġelün-üžin-i: Höġelün-Üžin — Högelün-Üjin, a woman's name; accusative -i, as object (name + case; Ming 婦人名 行) [婦人名 行]
glossary.delbege-dēče: delbege — rein, halter (noun; Ming 韁索); ablative -dēče, 'from, by the rein' (front-vowel form with a long ē; Ming 處) [韁索 處]
glossary.kilikü: kilikü — shaft of a cart (noun; Ming 車轅) [車轅]
glossary.dergečežü: dergeče- — to hold fast, cling to (Ming 𠊓, a rare character; stem uncertain); converb -žü, 'clinging' (verb, converb) [𠊓著︀]
glossary.aisuqui-dur: aisu- — to come; participle -qui + dative-locative -dur, 'at the coming, when coming' (verb, participle + case; Ming 來時) [來時]
glossary.keküli: kekül — tuft of hair, hair-knot (reading uncertain; Ming 髯揫); the (i) is Shiratori's and belongs to the reflexive -(i)jen that follows as the token jen (noun) [髯揫(自的行)]
glossary.keisümüser: keisü- — to blow (of wind; Ming 刮); negative past -müser, 'never blown' (verb, negative past; the ending is read from the Ming 不曾 'never') [不曾刮]
glossary.keġer: keġer — wild, open country, the steppe (noun or adjective; Ming 野) [野]
glossary.keġeli-ben: keġeli — belly; reflexive-possessive -ben, 'one's own belly' (noun + reflexive-possessive; Ming 肚 + 自的行) [肚 自的(行)]
glossary.ölöšümüser: ölöš- — to hunger, be hungry (Ming 飢); negative past -müser, 'never hungry' (verb, negative past) [不曾飢]
glossary.büliġi: bü- — to be; past -liġi, 'there was' (verb, past; the Ming 有來 is the same as for büleġe, and I take it for a variant of it) [有來]
glossary.ker: ker — how, what manner (interrogative adverb; Ming 怎生); in ker ele, 'how, of what sort' [怎生]
glossary.šibülgeli: šibülgel — braid, queue (reading uncertain; Ming 練椎, where 椎 is 'mallet'); the (i) is Shiratori's and belongs to the reflexive -(i)jen that follows as the token jen (noun) [練︀椎 自的行]
glossary.nigente: nigen — one; dative-locative -te, here 'once, one time' (numeral + case; the Ming 遍 'time, turn' is the only evidence; uncertain) [一遍] · also 'at one blow' (nigente deledüġed, 'struck once'; Ming 一下)
glossary.aru: aru — back (of the body), behind (noun; Ming 背) [背]
glossary.deġere-jen: deġere — above, upon; reflexive-possessive -jen, 'upon one's own' (adverb/noun + reflexive-possessive, front-vowel form; Ming 上 + 自的行) [上 自的(行)]
glossary.oγ̇orču: oγ̇or- — to throw, toss, fling (Ming 丢; stem uncertain); converb -čü, 'throwing' (verb, converb) [丢著︀]
glossary.ebür-ġen: ebür — bosom, lap (noun; Ming 懷裏); reflexive-possessive -ġen, 'one's own bosom' (noun + reflexive-possessive, front-vowel form after r) [懷裏自的(行)]
glossary.uruγšida: uru- — front, forward (stem uncertain; Ming 前); directional -γšida, 'toward' (Ming 向): 'forward' (noun + directional) [向前]
glossary.qoinaγšida: qoina — behind, after; directional -γšida, 'toward' (Ming 向): 'backward' (noun + directional) [向後]
glossary.odumui: od- — to go; present -mui, 'goes' (verb, present; Ming 去有) [去有]
glossary.kēġed: keġe- — to say; converb -ġed, 'having said' (verb, converb; keġe- + -ġed run together and written with a long ē; Ming 說了) [說了]

glossary.šiṅgežü: šiṅge- — to set, sink (stem inferred from Ming 落着); converb -žü, 'setting' (verb, converb) [落着]
glossary.duġušin: duġušin — dusk, twilight (noun; Ming 黃昏) [黃昏]
glossary.baruγ̇an: baruγan — dark, darkness (stem uncertain, Ming 黑了) [黑了]
glossary.boldažu: bolda- — to be made, become (passive; stem uncertain, Ming 被黑做着 'be made dark'); converb -žu, 'being made …' (verb, passive converb) [被黑做着]

glossary.qubijalduja: qubi- — to share out, divide (stem inferred from Ming 分); reciprocal -jaldu- + hortative -ja, 'let us divide among ourselves' (verb, hortative; shape uncertain) [分咱]
glossary.kėdüi-ji: kėdüi — how many, how much (interrogative; Ming 幾多); accusative -ji [幾多 行]
glossary.abqu: ab- — to take; participle -qu, 'that will take' (verb, participle) [要]
glossary.nökör-i: nökör — companion, comrade; accusative -i (noun + case; Ming 伴當 行) [伴當 行]
glossary.nökör-e: nökör — companion, comrade; dative-locative -e, 'to a companion' (noun + case; Ming 伴當行) [伴當行]
glossary.tusa: tusa — use, help, benefit (noun; Ming 濟) [濟]
glossary.bolsu: bol- — to become, be; optative -su, 'let me be' (verb, optative) [做]
glossary.nököčežü: nököče- — to be a companion (from nökör); converb -žü, 'being a companion' (verb, converb) [做伴着]
glossary.önžē-ü: önžē — extra goods, outside wealth (noun; sense uncertain, Ming 外財); genitive -ü (noun + case; the genitive is uncertain) [外財]
glossary.žüġegsen: žüġe- — to put by, lay up (stem inferred from Ming 置來的); past participle -gsen, 'what has been laid up' (verb, participle) [置來的]
glossary.tügetele: tüge- — to suffice, be enough (stem inferred from Ming 儘勾); -tele 'to the full' (verb + converb; uncertain) [儘勾]
glossary.boγ̇orču-ji: Boγ̇orču — Bo'orchu, a man's name; accusative -ji after a vowel, 'Bo'orchu (object)' (name + case) [人名行]
glossary.žaγažu: žaγa- — to lose, miss (stem inferred from the Ming 失); converb -žu, 'losing, having lost' (verb, converb) [失着]
glossary.nilbusu-bar: nilbusu — tear; instrumental -bar, 'with tears' (noun + case; the Ming adds 敎 'cause'; uncertain) [淚 敎]
glossary.genedte: genedte — suddenly (adverb; the Ming 忽然 is the only evidence) [忽然]
glossary.kürtežü: kürte- — to arrive, come to (from kür- 'reach'; uncertain); converb -žü, 'arriving' (verb, converb) [到着]
glossary.uilamu: uila- — to weep; present -mu, 'weeps, is weeping' (verb, present tense) [哭有]
glossary.doṅγodumu: doṅγodu- — to marvel, think strange (stem inferred from the Ming 怪, which may also mean 'blame'); present -mu, 'wonders' (verb, present tense) [怪有]
glossary.buγuγsan: buγu- — to cover over (stem inferred from the Ming; uncertain); participle -γsan, 'that has covered' (verb, past participle) [葢了的]
glossary.künesü: künesü — provisions for a journey (noun) [行糧]
glossary.ögüġed: ög- — to give; converb -üġed, 'having given' (verb, converb; linking vowel + -ġed) [與了]
glossary.deġürge: deġürge — load, pack (noun, from deġür- 'to load, carry') [駄的]
glossary.künesüleġülbe: künesüle- — to make provisions (künesü + -le-); causative -ġül-, past -be, 'had provisions made' (verb, causative past) [行糧敎做了]
glossary.žalaγ̇us: žalaγ̇u — young man, youth; plural -s, 'young men' (noun + plural) [少年每]
glossary.üželdügtüd: üže- — to see, look to; reciprocal -ldü-, 'look on one another'; imperative -gtüd, 'do ye ...!' (verb, reciprocal imperative, second person plural) [相顧您]
glossary.mönö: mönö — tomorrow, next day (adverb; the Ming 明 is the only evidence; with qoina 'from now on') [明]
glossary.tebčildügtüd: tebči- — to forsake, abandon (stem inferred from the Ming); reciprocal -ldü-, imperative -gtüd, '... one another, do ye!' (verb, reciprocal imperative, second person plural; inferred) [相棄您]
glossary.kiġed: kiġed — and, and the others (conjunction; perhaps converb of ki- 'do', inferred) [等]
glossary.herüžü: herü- — to grieve, be anxious (stem inferred from the Ming); converb -žü, 'grieving' (verb, converb) [愁着]
glossary.bajasba: bajas- — to rejoice; past -ba, 'rejoiced' (verb, past tense) [喜歡了]
glossary.börte-üžin-i: Börte-Üžin — Börte-Üjin, a woman's name (one two-part name); accusative -i, 'Börte-Üjin (object)' (name + case) [人名 行]
glossary.kelüren: Kelüren — the Kerülen, a river name [河名]
glossary.čiγurγu: Čiγurγu — Chigurgu, a mountain name [山名]
glossary.uṅgirad: Uṅgirad — the Ongirad (Shiratori's spelling Uṅgirad), a people or clan name (the -d is probably plural) [姓氏]
glossary.bajasču: bajas- — to rejoice; converb -ču, 'rejoicing, having rejoiced' (verb, converb) [喜歡]
glossary.naitamu: naita- — to envy, be jealous (stem inferred from the Ming); present -mu, 'envies' (verb, present tense) [嫉妒]
glossary.medežü: mede- — to know; converb -žü, 'knowing' (verb, converb) [知着]
glossary.čüköleġei: čüköle- — to lose hope, despair (stem inferred from the Ming); -ġei, ending of uncertain tense (verb; inferred) [絕望]
glossary.aran: aran — scarcely, only just (adverb; the Ming 僅得 is the only evidence) [僅得]
glossary.neileġüleġed: neile- — to join, unite (Ming 相配 'match'); causative -ġül-, converb -ġed, 'having joined together' (verb, causative converb) [相配了]
glossary.eġüsgebe: eġüsge- — to send off, see off (stem inferred from the Ming); past -be, 'sent off' (verb, past tense) [送將去了]
glossary.eġüsgen: eġüsge- — to send off, see off (stem inferred from the Ming); converb -n, 'sending off' (verb, converb) [迭]
glossary.kerülen-ü: Kerülen — the Kerülen, a river; genitive -ü, 'of the Kerülen' (name + case, front-vowel form) [河名 的]
glossary.uraγčul-nu-dāča: Uraγčul — Uraqchul, a place name; genitive -nu, ablative -dāča, 'from (the place) of Uraqchul' (name + case + case; Ming 隅自 'from the corner'; analysis uncertain) [地名 的 隅自]
glossary.qariba: qari- — to turn back, return; past -ba, 'returned' (verb, past tense) [囘了]
glossary.börte-üžin-ü: Börte-Üžin — Börte-Üjin, a woman's name; genitive -ü, 'of Börte-Üjin' (name + case, front-vowel form) [妻名 的]
glossary.sotan: Sotan — Sotan, a woman's name, mother of Börte-Üjin (personal name) [母名]
glossary.öki-jen: öki — daughter, girl; reflexive-possessive -jen, 'one's own daughter' (noun + reflexive-possessive, after a vowel) [女子 自的行]
glossary.kürgežü: kürge- — to bring to, deliver (kür- 'reach' made causative; uncertain); converb -žü, 'delivering' (verb, converb) [送到着]
glossary.qariγuluγ̇ad: qari- — to turn back, return; causative -γul-, converb -γ̇ad, 'having sent back' (verb, causative converb) [敎囘了]
glossary.nököčeje: nököče- — to be a companion, keep company (from nökör 'companion'); hortative -je, 'let us be companions' (verb, hortative, first person plural) [做伴咱]
glossary.kürġeġülüġed: kürge- — to bring to, deliver (kür- 'reach' made causative; uncertain); causative -ġül-, converb -üġed, 'having caused to arrive, having brought' (verb, causative converb) [敎到了]
glossary.ečige-düri: ečige — father; dative-locative -dür with the bracketed i of -(i)jen, 'to (one's own) father' (noun + case; the token left before -jen) [父 自的行]
glossary.bögötür: bögötür — humped, high-backed (adjective, of an animal's back; from the Ming 拱脊, inferred) [拱脊]
glossary.unuγ̇ad: unu- — to ride, mount; converb -γ̇ad, 'having mounted' (verb, converb) [騎了]
glossary.örmüge-ben: örmüge — woollen cloak, felt mantle (uncertain); reflexive-possessive -ben, 'one's own cloak' (noun + reflexive-possessive) [毛袗 自的行]
glossary.bögtürüġed: bögtür- — to tie on behind, load behind (stem uncertain); converb -üġed, 'having loaded behind' (verb, converb) [捎駄了]
glossary.belgütei-lüġe: Belgütei — Belgütei, a man's name; comitative -lüġe, 'with Belgütei' (name + case) [人名 一同]
glossary.nököčegseġer: nököče- — to be a companion (from nökör); participle -gsen + instrumental -ġer, 'because of having kept company' (verb, participle + case) [自做伴了]
glossary.nököčeküi: nököče- — to be a companion (from nökör); participle -küi, 'that keeps company, keeping company' (verb, participle) [做伴的]
glossary.γoroqan-ača: γoroqan — small river, stream; ablative -ača, 'from the stream' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [小河 自]
glossary.müren-ü: müren — river, a great river; genitive -ü, 'of the river' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [河的]
glossary.burgi: Burgi — Burgi, a place name [地名]
glossary.ergi-de: ergi — bank, shore, side; dative-locative -de, 'on the bank' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [岸 行]
glossary.nutuγlan: nutuγla- — to make a camping ground, settle (nutuγ 'camping ground' + -la-); converb -n, 'camping' (verb, converb) [營盤做]
glossary.šidkül: šidkül — gift made on first meeting the husband's parents (sense from the Ming 一見公姑的禮) (noun) [一見公姑的禮]
glossary.daqu-ji: daqu — fur coat, jacket; accusative -ji after a vowel, 'the coat (object)' (noun + case) [襖子 行]
glossary.qān: qān — ruler, sovereign, khan (title, the short form beside qaγan; here after a name) [皇帝]
glossary.ečige-lüġe: ečige — father; comitative -lüġe, 'with (one's) father' (noun + case) [父 一同]
glossary.kereid: Kereid — the Kereid, a people name (the -d is probably plural) [種名]
glossary.waṅ-qān: Waṅ-Qān — Wang Qan, ruler of the Kereid (personal name; Chinese wang 'prince' + qan) [人名]
glossary.anda: anda — sworn brother, pledged friend (noun) [契交]
glossary.keġeldügsen: keġe- — to say; reciprocal -ldü-, participle -gsen, 'that have said to one another, mutually declared' (verb, reciprocal participle) [相說的]
glossary.waṅ-qān-i: Waṅ-Qān — Wang Qan; accusative -i, 'Wang Qan (object)' (name + case) [(人)名行]
glossary.tuγ̇ula-jin: Tuγ̇ula — the Tuula (Tula) river; genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of the Tuula' (name + case) [河名 的]
glossary.waṅ-qān-dur: Waṅ-Qān — Wang Qan; dative-locative -dur, 'to Wang Qan' (name + case, back-vowel form) [人名行]
glossary.baγ̇ulžu: baγ̇ul- — to make alight, set down (causative of baγu-; the sense 'take in a wife' is a guess); converb -žu, 'setting down' (verb, causative converb; inferred) [下着]
glossary.emüsgeg: emüsgeg — gift presented on first meeting (Ming 上見; uncertain) (noun) [上見]
glossary.daqu-jin: daqu — fur coat, jacket; genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of the coat' (noun + case) [襖子 的]
glossary.qaγačaγsan: qaγača- — to part from, separate from; participle -γsan, 'that has parted' (verb, past participle) [離了的]
glossary.qamtudqažu: qamtudqa- — to bring together, unite (from qamtu 'together'); converb -žu, 'uniting' (verb, converb) [相合着]
glossary.butaraγsan: butara- — to scatter, disperse; participle -γsan, 'that has scattered' (verb, past participle) [漫散了的]
glossary.bügüdkeldüžu: bügüdkeldü- — to make complete, make whole (stem inferred from the Ming); converb -žu, 'making whole' (verb, converb; inferred) [完全着]
glossary.bögöre-jin: bögöre — kidney; genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of the kidney' (noun + case) [腰子 的]
glossary.bögse-dür: bögse — tip, point (uncertain); dative-locative -dür, 'at the point' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [尖兒裏]
glossary.čegere-jin: čegere — chest, trunk (uncertain); genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of the chest' (noun + case) [腔子 的]
glossary.čeġeži-dür: čeġeži — diaphragm, breast (uncertain); dative-locative -dür, 'at the diaphragm' (noun + case) [胷膈 裏]
glossary.atuγai: a- — to be, remain; optative -tuγai, 'let it be, let it stay' (verb, optative, third person) [存着]
glossary.burqan-qaldun-ača: Burqan-Qaldun — Burqan Qaldun, a mountain; ablative -ača, 'from Burqan Qaldun' (name + case, back-vowel form) [山名 自]
glossary.žarčiγ̇udai: Žarčiγ̇udai — Jarchiudai, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.küġürge-ben: küġürge — bellows (noun); reflexive-possessive -ben, 'one's own bellows' (noun + reflexive-possessive) [扇爐的風匣(自的)行]
glossary.ürču: ür- — to carry on the back (stem inferred from the Ming); converb -ču, 'carrying on the back' (verb, converb after r) [負着]
glossary.želme: Želme — Jelme, a son's name (personal name) [兒名]
glossary.töröküi-dür: törö- — to be born; participle -küi + dative-locative -dür, 'at the being born, when born' (verb, participle + case; Ming 生的 時) [生的 時]
glossary.nelkei: nelkei — cloth for wrapping a child, swaddling-cloth (noun) [褁兒的袱]
glossary.ögüleġe: ög- — to give; past -üleġe, 'gave, had given' (verb, past narrative; linking vowel + -leġe) [與了來]
glossary.želme-ji: Želme — Jelme; accusative -ji after a vowel, 'Jelme (object)' (name + case) [(兒)名 行]
glossary.emeġeli: emeġel — saddle (noun; inferred from the Ming 鞍子); with the bracketed i of -(i)jen, 'one's own saddle' (noun + reflexive-possessive; the token left before -jen) [鞍子 自(的)行]
glossary.toquγ̇ul: toqu- — to saddle (stem inferred from the Ming); causative -γ̇ul, 'make saddle, have saddled' (verb, causative stem) [敎鞴]
glossary.eġüd-ġen: eġüd — door (uncertain); reflexive-possessive -ġen after d, 'one's own door' (noun + reflexive-possessive) [門 自(的)行]
glossary.negüġül: nege- — to open (stem inferred from the Ming); causative -ġül, 'make open, have opened' (verb, causative stem) [敎開]
glossary.üdürge-jin: üdürge — near daybreak (Ming 盡將明; analysis uncertain); genitive -jin after a vowel (noun + case; inferred) [盡將明]
glossary.ködölküi: ködöl- — to move, work (stem uncertain); participle -küi, 'that moves, moving' (verb, participle) [動使的]
glossary.γoγ̇aγčin: Γoγ̇aγčin — Qo'aqchin, a woman's name (personal name) [婦人名] · also an adjective, 'pale, ash-white' (Ming 慘白 'pale'), the same spelling as the woman's name
glossary.bosču: bos- — to rise; converb -ču, 'rising, having risen' (verb, converb) [起着]
glossary.bos: bos- — to rise, get up (bare stem used as a command) [起]
glossary.derbelü: derbelü- — to shake, tremble (stem; written apart from its ending, which follows as müi) [顫動]
glossary.müi: -müi — present tense ending: is, does (second part of a verb written in two words, as derbelü müi) [有]
glossary.tübüriġün: tübüriġün — sound of shaking, tremor (noun) [震的聲]
glossary.sonostamu: sonos- — to hear; -ta- 'obtains, is able' (Ming 得; uncertain); present -mu, 'is heard, one hears' (verb, present tense) [聽得有]
glossary.žalγamsiγtan: žalγamsiγtan — those who frighten or harass (Ming 擾怕了的; form uncertain, perhaps a plural in -tan; inferred) [擾怕了的(每)]
glossary.aqun-u: aqun-u — perhaps, may it not be (Ming 莫不有; analysis uncertain) [莫不有]
glossary.seriġülüdkün: seri- — to wake, be awake; causative -ġül-, plural imperative -dkün, 'wake ye!' (verb, causative imperative; analysis of the ending uncertain) [喚敎覺來]
glossary.bosbi: bos- — to rise; past -bi, 'rose' (verb, past tense; -bi a variant of -ba) [起了]
glossary.temüžin-tan: Temüžin — Temüjin; collective -tan, 'Temüjin and the others' (name + collective) [人名 等]
glossary.öterlen: öter — quickly; adverbial -len, 'quickly, at once' (adverb + suffix) [疾快]
glossary.bosuγ̇ad: bos- — to rise; converb -uγ̇ad, 'having risen' (verb, converb; linking vowel + -γ̇ad) [起了]
glossary.ebür-türi: ebür — lap, bosom; dative-locative -tür with the bracketed i of -(i)jen, 'in (one's own) lap' (noun + case; the token left before -jen) [懷裏 自的行]
glossary.deġürbe: deġür- — to carry, load; past -be, 'loaded, carried' (verb, past tense) [駄了]
glossary.žasaba: žasa- — to prepare, set in order; past -ba, 'prepared' (verb, past tense) [整治了]
glossary.börte-üžin-e: Börte-Üžin — Börte-Üjin; dative-locative -e, 'to Börte-Üjin' (name + case, front-vowel form) [婦人名行]
glossary.dutaba: duta- — to be lacking, fall short; past -ba, 'was lacking' (verb, past tense) [闕了]
glossary.burqan: Burqan — Burqan, the holy mountain (mountain name) [山名]
glossary.žüg: žüg — direction, side, place; after a name, 'toward' (noun used as a postposition) [處] · also žüg, 'each' (repeated: 'each each') (Ming 各 'each'), in the entrusting of the posts
glossary.niγ̇usu: niγu- — to hide (stem inferred from the Ming 要藏 'want to hide'); -su, probably the optative 'let me ...' (as in ögsü), so with keġen 'intending to hide' (verb; analysis uncertain) [要藏]
glossary.kölžü: köl- — to yoke, to harness (stem inferred from the Ming 駕着); converb -žü, 'harnessing' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [駕着]
glossary.teṅgeli: Teṅgeli — a river name (the Ming marks 河名); the same Han letters write teṅgeli, the cart's axle (Ming 車軸), so name and noun are not told apart by the letters (name or noun, uncertain) [河名]
glossary.ködölžü: ködöl- — to move, to set in motion (stem inferred from the Ming 動着); converb -žü, 'moving' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [動着]
glossary.horubaru-da: horubaru — half-dark, the dim time before day (Ming 尙昏時 'still dark'); dative-locative -da, 'in the half-dark' (noun + case) [尙昏時 行]
glossary.esergünēče: esergü — facing, against, to meet; ablative -ēče, 'from the front, from the opposite side' (adverb + case, long vowel) [迎自]
glossary.hergižü: hergi- — to circle, to wheel round (stem inferred from the Ming 旋着); converb -žü, 'circling' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [旋着]
glossary.temüžin-ü-ġei: Temüžin — Temüjin; genitive -ü + -ġei, 'one belonging to Temüjin' (name + case + suffix; the -ġei is uncertain, the Ming 的 only marks possession) [人名 的]
glossary.kirγara: kirγa- — to shear, to clip (stem inferred from the Ming 剃); ending -ra, 'in order to' (verb; analysis uncertain) [剃]
glossary.aiši: ai- — to come (compare aisu-, aisun); ending -ši, 'am coming, is coming' (verb, present; analysis uncertain, resting on the Ming 有) [來有] · also (uncertain) an imperative, 'come!', read from the bare Ming 來; the ending -ši cannot be decided from the Ming
glossary.bijü-ü: bü- — to be; present bijü, 'there is' + question particle -ü (Ming 麽) (verb + particle) [有麽]
glossary.kežige: kežige — how far, to what distance (Ming 幾遠; form uncertain) (adverb) [幾遠]
glossary.uqabi: uqa- — to know, to understand; past -bi, 'knew, understood' (verb, past tense; -bi a variant of -ba) [省]
glossary.irebi: ire- — to come; past -bi, 'came' (verb, past tense; -bi a variant of -ba) [來了]
glossary.čeriġüd: čerig — soldier; plural -d, 'soldiers' (noun + plural; the vowel is Shiratori's linking -ü-) [軍每]
glossary.qataraba: qatara- — to urge on, to gallop (Ming 點着去 'prod and go'; uncertain); past -ba, 'rode on' (verb, past tense) [點着去了]

glossary.qučar-beki: Qučar-Beki — Quchar-Beki, a man's name (personal name) [人名]

glossary.qara-žürügen-ü: Qara-Žürügen — Qara-Jürügen, 'Black Heart', a place name (place name); -ü genitive: of (front-vowel form after n) [地名 的]

glossary.qučar: Qučar — Quchar, a man's name (personal name) [人名]

glossary.dain-dur: dain — enemy, war, battle (noun; Ming 敵); -dur dative-locative: at, against (back-vowel form) [敵行]

glossary.qarγam: qarγam — rump, haunch, hip-joint (noun; Ming 臀節 'hip joint') [臀節︀]

glossary.oroγ̇a: oroγ̇a — cunning, wary (adjective; Ming 狡) [狡]

glossary.göreġešün-ü: göreġešün — game, wild animals (a spelling beside göreġesün; Ming 野獸); -ü genitive: of (front-vowel form after n) [野獸 的]
glossary.nigetele: nigetele — all together, all at once (Ming 一幷 'altogether'; probably from nigen 'one' with an ending) [一幷]
glossary.šiγažu: šiγa- — to squeeze, press together (stem inferred; Ming 擠); -žu converb: -ing (back-vowel form) [擠着]

glossary.qaγačaγ̇ulžu: qaγača- — to part, to separate; -γ̇ul- causative: cause to ...; -žu converb: -ing (back-vowel form) [敎分離着]

glossary.eṅke: eṅke — peace, calm (noun; Ming 太平) [太平]
glossary.ebdeġesü: ebde- — to destroy, break (stem inferred; Ming 壞); -ġesü conditional converb: if, when (front-vowel form; compare -γ̇asu) [壞呵]
