glossary.köġü-dēče: köġü — child, son (beside köġün; Ming 子); -dēče ablative: from (front-vowel form with a long ē) [子 處]
glossary.hiričeγ̇ülžü: hiriče- — to part, to separate (stem inferred; Ming 分離; compare qaγača-); -γ̇ül- causative: cause to ...; -žü converb: -ing (front-vowel form) [分離着]
glossary.eže: eže — lord, master (noun; Ming 主; compare ežen) [主]
glossary.baraldužu: baraldu- — to settle together, agree (stem inferred; Ming 議定 'settle on'); -žu converb: -ing (back-vowel form) [議定着]
glossary.aldažu: aldaž- — to swear, take an oath (stem inferred; Ming 誓); -žu converb: -ing (back-vowel form) [誓着]
glossary.ögölei-čerbi: Ögölei-Čerbi — Ögölei-Cherbi, a man's name (personal name; the meaning of čerbi is not known from these sources) [人名]
glossary.aγsaba: aγsa- — to wear, carry at the belt (stem inferred; Ming 帶 'wear, carry'); -ba past (back-vowel form) [帶了]
glossary.doqolqu-čerbi: Doqolqu-Čerbi — Doqolqu-Cherbi, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.öṅgür: Öṅgür — Önggür, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.qadaγ̇an-daldurqan: Qadaγ̇an-Daldurqan — Qada'an-Daldurqan, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.manaγar-un: manaγar — morning, early morning (Ming 淸早 'early'); -un genitive: of (back-vowel form after a consonant) [淸早 的]
glossary.undan: undan — drink, beverage (noun; Ming 飮) [飮]
glossary.meküdeġülsüġei: meküde- — to be lacking, run short (stem inferred; Ming 缺少); -ġül- causative: cause to ...; -süġei optative: 'may ...' (front-vowel form of -suγai) [缺少了]
glossary.üde-jin: üde — evening (noun; Ming 晩夕); -jin genitive: of (after a vowel) [晩夕 的]
glossary.osoldasuγai: osolda- — to be slack, to neglect (stem inferred; Ming 怠慢); -suγai optative: 'may ...' (back-vowel form) [怠慢了]
glossary.baγ̇určin: baγ̇určin — cook (noun; Ming 厨子) [厨子]
glossary.šilegü: šilegü — two-year-old, of two years (adjective; Ming 二歲) [二歲]
glossary.irge: irge — wether, castrated ram (noun; Ming 羯羊) [羯羊]
glossary.sülen: sülen — soup, broth (noun; Ming 湯) [湯]
glossary.meküdešü: meküde- — to be lacking, run short (stem inferred; Ming 缺); -šü optative ending (a spelling of -sü; uncertain) [缺了]

glossary.alam: alam — underside of a cart, cart-bed (Ming 車底 'cart bottom'; sense uncertain) [車底]

glossary.qoṅγoγčiγ̇ud: qoṅγoγčiγ̇ud — the yellow ones (plural; Ming 黄色; analysis uncertain) [黄色]

glossary.qoγ̇olančar: qoγ̇olančar — greedy, gluttonous (adjective; Ming 饞) [饞]

glossary.aduγ̇ulaba: aduγ̇ula- — to herd, to pasture; -ba past (back-vowel form) [牧放了]
glossary.soγ̇orγatai: soγ̇orγa — lock, catch (noun; Ming 鎖 'lock'; sense uncertain); -tai possessive: having (back-vowel form) [鎖 有的]

glossary.qaraldai-toquraγ̇un: Qaraldai-Toquraγ̇un — Qaraldai-Toqura'un, a man's name (personal name) [人名]

glossary.aγtačin: aγta — gelding (noun); -čin agent suffix: one who looks after ... (Ming 籠馬人 'the one who ropes the horses') [籠馬人]

glossary.moriči: Moriči — Morichi, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.aduγ̇u: aduγ̇u — herd of horses (noun; Ming 馬羣) [馬羣]

glossary.odora: odora — an arrow name (Ming 箭名) [箭名]
glossary.baγ̇atur: baγ̇atur — hero, brave warrior (a title following a name; Ming 勇士) [勇士]
glossary.qurijaldusu: qurija- — to gather up, tidy (stem inferred; Ming 收拾); -ldu- reciprocal: 'together, jointly' (Ming 共); -su optative: 'let me ...' (back-vowel form) [共收拾]
glossary.keriġe: keriġe — crow, raven (noun; Ming 老鴉) [老鴉]
glossary.γadaγ̇un: γadaγ̇un — outside, outer (Ming 在外) [在外]
glossary.bükün-i: bü- — to be; -kün participle ending: 'those who are' (Ming 有的; uncertain); -i accusative: marks the object [有的 行]

glossary.terge: terge — cart (noun; the first half of tergeġür 'cart-track', cut at a line end in Shiratori's text; the whole word is tergeġür; Ming 車) [車]
glossary.ġüri: ġür — track, road (noun; the second half of terge-ġür 'cart-track', cut at a line end); the (i) is Shiratori's and belongs to the instrumental -(i)jer that follows as the token jer, 'along' (Ming 路 + 依着) [路依着]

glossary.teġü: teġü- — to be ruined, to break down (verb stem inferred; Ming 敎壞 'cause to ruin'); the first half of teġü-reġülšü, cut at a line end, the causative and optative following as the token reġülšü [敎壞]
glossary.sübeġetei: Sübeġetei — Sübegetei, a man's name (personal name; the first half of Sübeġetei-Baγ̇atur, cut at a line end; the title baγ̇atur 'hero' follows) [人名]

glossary.sedkil-dür: sedkil — heart, mind; dative-locative -dür, 'in the heart' (noun + case, front-vowel form; Ming 裏) [心 裏]
glossary.žirüge: žirüge — heart (a second word for 'heart', beside sedkil; the same as žürüge) (noun) [心]
glossary.čeġeži: čeġeži — breast, bosom (noun; Ming 胷懷) [胷懷]

glossary.anda-ača: anda — sworn brother, pledged friend (Ming 契合); ablative -ača, 'from the sworn brother' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [(契合)處]
glossary.nököčešü: nököče- — to be a companion (from nökör; stem inferred); -šü, an ending of exhortation (uncertain; the Ming 做伴我 'be a companion to me'), 'let ... be companions' (verb, ending uncertain) [做伴我]
glossary.ötögüs: ötögü(n) — old man, elder; plural -s, 'elders' (noun + plural) [老的每]
glossary.ölže: ölže — good fortune, blessing (noun; the first part of ölže-ten, split by the line break) [吉慶]

glossary.boluγ̇užai: bol- — to become; ending -uγ̇užai (uncertain; the Ming 做麽 reads it as a question, 'shall (they) become?') (verb, ending uncertain) [做麽]
glossary.tüšibe: tüši- — to entrust, to commit to (Ming 委付); past -be, 'entrusted' (verb, past, front-vowel form) [委付了]
glossary.tan-i: tan- — you (plural polite; stem of ta before a case ending); accusative -i, 'you' as object (pronoun + case) [您行]
glossary.qān-dur: qān — ruler, khan (the short form beside qaγan); dative-locative -dur, 'to the qan' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [皇帝 行]
